title: Apple Music plays every song of a class on iPhone Safari
acceptance: Ritmo no longer sets mk-safari-modern-eme on iOS Safari or legacy WebKit, and clears a stored "1" before MusicKit loads and before each queue/play, so MusicKit stays on its default FairPlay path.
Unit tests cover clearing a stored flag before the MusicKit script loads (WebKitMediaKeys and iOS Safari UA), never setting it, and leaving desktop Chrome storage alone.
Owner hears Start, Pause/Resume, Next and auto-advance in iPhone Safari Live on the deployed bundle with no console changes; RF-29 records it.

evidence.summary: Owner iPhone Safari 2026-10-28, console-driven: setQueue({songs:['1440754477']}) timed out at 20 s twice without Emulate User Gesture and resolved in 313 ms with it. runtime.ts awaits prepare (setQueue) before play().

Owner iPhone Safari, 5G, Worker b41b99f9 (RF-122 live), screen recording 23:06: Start class played Break Stuff after about 5 s. Pause worked. Resume stuck on 'Waiting for music — Provider playback has not confirmed progress'. Next to Rollin' (Air Raid Vehicle) showed 'Playback stopped' with Playback error at class clock 2:47.

Owner iPhone Safari (iOS 27.0.1), Wi-Fi, bundle index-BTdVQWvK.js, Worker b41b99f9, Web Inspector probe 09:24-09:56. With mk-safari-modern-eme=1 (set by Ritmo): first song plays and un-pause works, but every later song load (setQueue, skipToNextItem, changeToMediaAtIndex, natural end of a 2-song queue, and a real tap on an injected button) resolved or aborted with MusicKit stopped and no item. With the flag removed and blocked before MusicKit loaded: Ritmo's own Start, Next (Rollin' played), Pause/Resume and auto-advance (track 2 start → advancing) all played on production code.
Clears the modern FairPlay flag instead of setting it (musickit.ts, apple-music-adapter.ts) with tests.
Deployed 2026-10-29: Worker 2a302ce6-7665-47d2-8f79-68d6822450b1 at main d81c0fc, SPA assets/index-Cqjj6m_w.js; rollback b41b99f9. Smoke and headers passed; tail watch and authed smoke not done.

Owner iPhone Safari Live on production Worker 2a302ce6 (main d81c0fc, SPA index-Cqjj6m_w.js), 2026-10-29, two runs reported in session. Run 1: class started and the song played; Next twice played songs 2 and 3; Previous worked. Run 2: Pause/Resume, a seek, and a song ending on its own with the next starting all worked with no bugs. Network for each run and Start delay not recorded.

Matrix row: iPhone iOS 27.0.1 Safari Apple Music on production Worker 2a302ce6 (SPA index-Cqjj6m_w.js), 2026-10-29: Pass for Start, Next, Previous, Pause/Resume, seek and auto-advance, owner-witnessed with no console changes reported.

resolution: Fixed by #657 (stop forcing modern FairPlay; clear a stored mk-safari-modern-eme). The owner heard Start, Next to songs 2 and 3, Previous, Pause/Resume, seek and auto-advance in iPhone Safari Live on the deployed build on 2026-10-29. Desktop Safari on the legacy path stays with RF-126; resume in place and the RF-123 lock fix stay on PR #656; review follow-ups are in the #657 PR comment.
